# Helm releases { .quad-reference }

Every `HelmRelease`, the chart it installs and where from, how often
helm-controller re-checks it, and where its values come from. Chart versions
are deliberately absent — Renovate moves them several times a week, and the
linked manifest is where they live. For why values come from a ConfigMap
and why the interval matters, see
[why Helm values live in a file](../explanation/helm-values.md).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Intervals in use** | `5m` |
| **Charts used more than once** | `cnpg-database` ×13, `versitygw` ×2, `traefik` ×2 |
